components.mapping: OnlineMapper receives a QueryBackend; model reconstruction and snapshot lifecycle stay in pbsp/mapping.
components.semantic_injection: Warmup and incremental encoding call SemanticInjector. Actual pooling and codebook operations live in pbsp/semantics; the default adapter supplies semantic resources without geometry layers.
components.query: SemanticQuery composes independent QuerySettings, TextEncoder and a SemanticIndex reader. The EmbodiedSplat adapter converts Gaussian storage to metric Habitat world coordinates before retrieval.
components.navigation: The running Navigator dispatches through NavigationBackend. WaypointNavigationBackend supports an external waypoint controller with separate exploration fallback and explicit reset/close lifecycle.

failures: A temporary runtime fixture references the server-only dataset path.
Two macOS OpenCV thread-limit checks report 10 threads after requesting 8.
local_complete_suite.note: All three cases pass in the Linux complete suite. Assertions were retained. The temporary machine-local runtime file was removed after testing; the architecture validator then passed locally.
